_comment: Mirrors docs/rules-provenance.md — keep in sync. Quotes verified against the linked texts (2026-09-18). Thresholds stay placeholders; 'regulation-informed' only when status is a requirement or guidance.

R1.source: Fed/OCC SR 11-7, Guidance on Model Risk Management, §V
R1.quote: The range and rigor of validation activities conducted prior to first use of a model

R2.quote: Verification of market prices and model inputs shall be performed … at least monthly

R3.source: Senate PSI report, JPMorgan Chase Whale Trades (2013), Recommendation 3
R3.quote: deviations from midpoint prices … to be quantified, explained, and, if appropriate, investigated

R4.quote: deviations from midpoint prices over the course of a month

R5.source: CRR Art. 105(8) — independence of the verifying unit
R5.quote: performed by a person or unit independent from persons or units that benefit

R6.source: Senate PSI report, Finding of fact 3 (Hid Massive Losses)
R6.quote: hid over $660 million in losses in the Synthetic Credit Portfolio for several months

R7.quote: periodic review—at least annually but more frequently if warranted—of each model

R8.quote: reporting lines … clear and independent of the front office

R9.quote: documented policies and procedures for the process of valuation
